name: Candidate Invite
response:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},


I hope this email finds you well. We would like to express our appreciation for your interest in joining our team at Minix Holding Private Limited. We have carefully reviewed your application, and we're excited about the potential opportunity to work together.


Before we proceed further in the hiring process, we kindly ask you to fill out some additional details to help us better understand your qualifications and preferences. Please take a moment to complete the form at the following link:


https://minixholdings.frappe.cloud/job-applicant/new


Your responses will assist us in assessing your fit for the role and ensuring that we can provide you with the best possible experience throughout the recruitment process.


If you have any questions or encounter any issues while filling out the form, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We're here to help and ensure a smooth process for you.


Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to reviewing your completed application details.


Best regards,


Ishita Kapadia

Minix Holding Pvt. Ltd.

Contact Info.
